LandingStudio.title: Your ideas.
LandingStudio.intro: Explore, write, and build with T. Give that thought in your head a life of its own.
LandingStudio.chooseScene: Choose what to do with T
LandingStudio.placeholder: Hey T, I have an idea…
LandingStudio.portraitAlt: T with navy mullet hair, green eyes and headphones, smiling with her cheek resting on her hand.

build.label: Build
build.title: Less stuck. More done.
build.body: From a stubborn bug to your next side project. Work through it with T.
build.prompt: Help me turn my side-project idea into a working prototype. Ask me what I want to build first.
build.alt: T focuses on a laptop, her layered navy mullet and green eyes visible.

explore.label: Explore
explore.title: Follow the good questions.
explore.body: Explore a topic, connect the pieces, and find a clearer way forward.
explore.prompt: Help me explore an idea in depth. Ask me about the topic and what I want to learn.
explore.alt: T considers an idea, holding a notebook and resting a finger against her cheek.

create.label: Create
create.title: Make it feel like you.
create.body: Bring a rough thought. Shape it into a story, a draft, or a new direction.
create.prompt: Help me turn my scattered notes into a story. Ask me for my notes and who it is for.
create.alt: T smiles thoughtfully with her cheek resting on her hand.

v3.eyebrow: A little spark. A place to begin.
v3.heroAlt: T sits in a sunlit studio above the clouds, surrounded by notebooks, models and floating pages.
v3.processIntro: A question, a few notes, a project on your mind. Give it somewhere to grow.
v3.meetBody: Curious, a little cheeky, and serious about getting things done. Talk through a rough idea, untangle a problem, or try a new skill together.
v3.finalIntro: That thing you’ve been meaning to make.

website.title: Start a personal website
website.prompt: Help me plan and build a personal website. First ask about its purpose, audience and the style I like.

research.title: Explore a question that matters
research.prompt: Help me research a topic and compare different perspectives. First ask about my question, then distinguish evidence from assumptions.

story.title: Give a small idea a bigger story
story.prompt: Help me develop a story from a small idea. First ask about the idea and the feeling I want readers to have.

debug.title: Untangle a stubborn bug
debug.prompt: Help me debug a problem. First ask for the error, relevant code and what I expected to happen.

learn.title: Make sense of something new
learn.prompt: Help me understand a new topic through clear examples. First ask what I want to learn and what I already know.

writing.title: Turn scattered notes into a draft
writing.prompt: Help me turn my notes into a clear draft. First ask me for the notes, audience and tone.

gather.title: Follow the spark
gather.body: Bring the question, the notes, the half-formed idea. Start with what you have, and find what’s worth exploring.
gather.prompt: I have some scattered notes and ideas. Help me find a useful starting point. First ask me to share them.
gather.alt: Loose pages drift toward a warmly lit archive on a lake beneath a crescent moon.

think.title: Find the connections
think.body: Compare perspectives, ask a better question, and work through the missing pieces with T. Clarity comes one conversation at a time.
think.prompt: Help me think through a difficult question. First ask what I am trying to decide and what I know so far.
think.action: Think through a question with T
think.alt: T studies a model and notebook in a glass conservatory lit by a warm desk lamp.

make.title: Make it real
make.body: A first draft. A working prototype. A plan you can act on. Shape it, try it, and keep making it yours.
make.prompt: Help me turn an idea into a concrete first version. First ask what I want to make and what a useful first result would look like.
make.action: Make a first version with T
make.alt: An illuminated thread connects a sketch to a small studio assembling above a meadow.
